description: This file defines an internal interface ILogConsistencyProtocolGateway within the Orleans.SystemTargetInterfaces namespace. The interface acts as a relay for forwarding protocol messages between clusters to the appropriate grain in Orleans's event sourcing system.

classes.name: ILogConsistencyProtocolGateway
classes.description: An internal interface serving as a relay for forwarding protocol messages between clusters in Orleans.

methods.name: RelayMessage
methods.description: Asynchronously relays a protocol message identified by GrainId with the provided payload.
